subject: Re: Slate retention pack + dashboard bundling concession
messages:
From: Alicia Barnes <alicia@stellarhealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Retention & dashboard packaging question

Hi Sean / Laura,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the advanced dashboards looked promising. Before our procurement kickoff I need a clear set of pricing options for Stellar's expected footprint so I can model cost to our CFO. Quick summary of our numbers:~
- Ingest ~4 TB / month (mostly logs + traces)
- Active retention target: 30 days for logs; 90 days for a subsection (audit), and longer-term archive to cold storage for compliance (365 days)
- Tracing volume: ~250k spans/day, sampling rates vary by service
- Advanced dashboards: ~12 power users, ~30 viewers

Can you send: a) 3 pricing options (PAYG, 12-month commit, enterprise reserved) that include retention tiering and dashboard seat pricing, b) any onboarding fees or one-time setup costs, and c) a sample commercial concession you typically offer for a pilot → annual commit conversion? Also please attach any sample SOW or pricing sheet.

Procurement will want to see per-GB retention rates and a clear uplift for tracing spans vs logs. If you can include a usage example using our numbers that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alicia Barnes
VP Engineering, Stellar Health
Alicia Barnes | Stellar Health
---
(Procurement: procurements@stellarhealth.com)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retention & dashboard packaging question

Alicia — thanks for the clear summary. Attached is a short proposal (Slate-Proposal-v2.pdf) and a worked example based on the numbers you provided. TL;DR on three clean options: 

1) Pay-as-you-go (no commit)
   - Logs retention: $0.035 / GB-month (30d)
   - Extended 90d: $0.028 / GB-month (applies to data flagged for audit)
   - Archive (365d cold): $0.009 / GB-month (cold tier)
   - Tracing: $0.0008 / span
   - Dashboards: $35 / power-user / month; $8 / viewer / month
   - Onboarding: $5,000 one-time

2) 12-month committed (recommended pilot → conversion) — 30% average discount vs PAYG, plus 1 month of dashboard seats free on conversion

3) Enterprise reserved (36-month, reserved capacity) — up to 45% discount on retention & tracing, onboarding fee waived, and we can include dashboards for first 3 months for up to 20 power users on negotiated commits. This tier also includes priority SLA (99.95%) and a commercial credit against overages for the first quarter.

Concession idea for pilots: we often waive onboarding for pilots where the customer agrees to a 12-month conversion within 90 days and commits to an ARR threshold. I'll note one worked sample in the attached PDF (uses your 4 TB ingest baseline).

If you want, let's set a 30-minute follow-up Tuesday to walk the numbers with your procurement person.

Attachments: Slate-Proposal-v2.pdf (pricing + worked example)

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Retention & dashboard packaging question

Ben — forwarding Alicia's ask and Sean's high-level options. Looks like a solid expansion motion; procurement will push hard on onboarding waiver and a larger discount if we include dashboards in the commit.

Quick ask: would you ok waiving the $5k onboarding fee if they sign a 12-mo commit at >= $250k ARR? Also, do we have flexibility to include the first 6 weeks of dashboard seats (power users) at no charge to ease product buy-in?

We should try to close the pilot → committed motion with a clear concession path documented. Sean — flag if the enterprise 45% off language is a hard ask or negotiable.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-24T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Retention & dashboard packaging question

Laura / Sean — we can move on concessions but want to preserve ARR economics. Approve the onboarding waiver contingent on a 12-month committed ARR >= $200k (we can be flexible down to $175k with CRO approval). For dashboard seats: include first 3 months of up to 15 power users and unlimited viewers for the pilot conversion path.

Notes on discount: reduce the advertised 45% enterprise discount to a target 35% off list in the term sheet; allow us to offer up to 40% with exec sign-off for larger commits (> $500k ARR).

I'll ask Legal to prepare an SOW template with the adjusted numbers (waived onboarding, 3 months seats, 35% discount baseline). Sean — get Stellar's procurement contact and a ballpark of intended commit ($) so I can route to CRO if needed.

Ben Carter
Director of Sales | Redwood Inference

Final offer (summary):
- Retention pricing (committed 12-mo conversion scenario, 30% discount off PAYG): 30d logs $0.0245 / GB-month; 90d audit tier $0.0196 / GB-month; 365d cold $0.0063 / GB-month.
- Tracing: $0.00056 / span (same discount applied)
- Dashboards: $22.75 / power-user / month (first 3 months included for up to 15 power users); $5.60 / viewer / month (first 3 months included)
- Onboarding fee: waived on committed 12-mo ARR >= $200k (if your expected commit is lower, we can discuss a reduced onboarding or exec approval path)
- Pilot concession: 1 month credit toward first invoice if conversion completed within 60 days of pilot start
- SLA: baseline 99.9%; upgrade to 99.95% available in Enterprise reserved path

Attached is the updated proposal and a worked example using your numbers (Stellar-usage-sample.csv attached). Next steps: please confirm that procurement is comfortable with the above and share the name/email of your procurement lead so I can route the SOW. If accepted we aim for an executed SOW within 10 business days.

> Ingest ~4 TB / month (mostly logs + traces)
